02 — Two metals, one shop

Stainless or copper? Start with the job.

Avenue Metal works in sheet metal of all types, including stainless steel and copper. Which one fits depends on the use, the finish you want, and the space — that call is made with the shop, by phone, once your specs are on the table.

Stainless steel

The workhorse of commercial kitchens and restaurants: hoods, sinks, counters, steam tables and ventilation, fabricated to the dimensions of your room.

  • Commercial kitchen manufacturing and design
  • Counters, sinks and cabinets sized to the space
  • Ventilation and steam tables in the same package

Copper

For kitchens, baths and one-off pieces where the metal itself is part of the look — custom work, finished to your specifications.

  • Custom residential and office kitchens and baths

05 — Questions buyers actually ask

Before you call, the straight answers.

Can you build a custom hood for my restaurant?

Yes — hoods are part of Avenue Metal's commercial kitchen manufacturing and design, alongside sinks, counters, steam tables, ventilation and custom fabricating. Bring your kitchen dimensions and layout, and confirm the build by phone.

Stainless steel or copper — which fits my project?

The shop works in sheet metal of all types, including stainless steel and copper. Stainless is the usual commercial-kitchen workhorse; copper suits kitchens, baths and artistic pieces where finish matters. The right call depends on your use and space — discuss it with the shop before you commit.

Do you handle full restaurant build-outs?

Yes — commercial kitchen and restaurant manufacturing and design is the shop's core: hoods, sinks, counters, steam tables, ventilation and custom fabricating as one package, made to fit the room.

Do you do residential or office kitchens and baths?

Yes — custom residential and office kitchens and baths, including copper and stainless work, designed around the space they serve.

What about a one-off artistic piece?

Artistic custom fabrications are part of the work — pieces shaped around an idea rather than a standard product line. Describe the idea in the builder below and call to discuss it.

How does a custom project start, and what does it cost?

Start with your specs in the builder below, then call (312) 243-3483 with the summary ready. Every price is confirmed by phone, so this page never quotes one.
